newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Videocon Int'l signs US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Videocon Int'l signs US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: Videocon International Ltd's US$50 million floating rate notes issue due December 2003 was signed on Wednesday in Bangkok, lead manager Peregrine Fixed Income said.
The seven-year notes were issued at par to float at 250 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Lead managers are Peregrine Fixed Income, KDLC Lease & Finance, Saehan Asia Finance, Bank of Commerce (L) Ltd, Bank of India and Sime International Bank (L) Ltd.
Senior managers are Cho Hung Leasing & Finance (HK), Hanmi Leasing & Finance (HK) and KEB Leasing & Finance.
Managers are CBK Leasing & Finance (HK), Gyongnam Merchant Banking Corp, Hanil Leasing & Finance (HK), Kookmin Leasing & Finance (HK) and Korea Leasing (Singapore) Pte.
